title: Really nice although a little smaller than I expected. Perfect to hold make up sponges and cotton balls.
text: Really nice although a little smaller than I expected. Perfect to hold make up sponges and cotton balls.. These are so cute! They look so shiny and nice I fell in love I like the top lids as well they are perfect for my bathroom and don't stand out too much like cheaper ones I've bought. I think they are just great for anything really!!! The only thing i did not like much was that the top lid is made of a material that gets dirty very easily but otherwise they look easy to clean anyway so I am happy! I really love the colour I got the pinkish ones myself.

product_metadata.title: mDesign Plastic Rectangle Apothecary Canister - Organizer for Bathroom Vanity Countertop Shelf Decor - Holds Cotton Swabs, Soap, Makeup, Bath Salts - Lumiere Collection - 2 Pack - White/Brushed Chrome
